description: The restaurant is themed as an old airline terminal. On the lower level, an airplane propeller display contains a classic Hidden Mickey.

whereToLook.scene: Airplane propeller display on the lower level
whereToLook.exactSpot: The propeller display. Look at the hub and mounting hardware for three circles.

bestTip: Take the stairs down even if your table is upstairs.

viewing.notes: Table-service restaurant; ask to look around if you are not dining.
